cause_definitions.abnormal_quote_volume: last-bar quote volume is below 0.6x or above 3x trailing median
cause_definitions.btc_direction_conflict: trade direction opposes BTC prior 24h return by at least 0.5%
cause_definitions.crowded_same_hour: at least three raw frozen entries share the entry hour
cause_definitions.failed_directional_breakout: last closed candle pierced prior 24h extreme but closed back inside
cause_definitions.market_breadth_conflict: fewer than 37.5% of tracked symbols align over prior 24h
cause_definitions.no_protective_level_before_stop: prior 24h low/high is more than 1.5% behind entry
cause_definitions.opposing_level_before_target: prior 72h high/low lies between entry and selected target
cause_definitions.opposing_order_block: uninvalidated 1% two-bar displacement block lies in target path
cause_definitions.stop_inside_hourly_atr: 14h ATR is at least the fixed 1% stop

limitations: OHLCV sweeps, levels and quote volume are liquidity proxies, not historical order-book depth.
Order blocks use one fixed reproducible definition; discretionary chart labels were not used.
Cause flags may overlap and describe pre-entry risk, not prove a unique causal mechanism.
The objective requires independent forward outcomes even if a historical guard passes.

protocol.input: frozen target-cascade rows; no entry or target retuning
